meta.title: Autonomous Engineering LLM Model Zoo & Free Tier Registry
meta.description: Comprehensive reference of tested local, cloud free-tier, and autonomous agent models for development, formal verification, and irregularity detection.

categories.name: Local Offline Models (Host GPU / Ollama)
categories.privacy: Zero Leak — 100% Offline, no external network calls

models.name: Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B
limitations: Cold start load from host NVMe takes ~40-45s
Host GPU thermal throttling on prolonged generation loops
Conservative on holistic multi-file architectural planning
models.tested_verdict: Verified live in host VRAM. Excellent for targeted edits and offline offline verification.

models.name: DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 7B
limitations: Thinking blocks increase generation token count
models.tested_verdict: Recommended for offline formal mathematical reasoning.

models.name: GLM 5.3 Flash Free
limitations: Occasional formatting quirks in raw JSON
models.tested_verdict: Extremely reliable and responsive. Successfully validated all 6 git repositories in sub-turnaround.

models.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free
limitations: Can underestimate human review friction on deep mathematical proofs
models.tested_verdict: Superb execution workhorse for repetitive code tasks.

models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free
limitations: Output can be verbose if prompt does not enforce strict brevity
models.tested_verdict: Best qualitative reasoning on project backlog and mathematical validation.

categories.name: OpenRouter Free-Tier Dynamic Registry (:free)
categories.privacy: Subject to individual provider privacy terms; :free endpoints may be rate-limited

models.name: OpenRouter Auto-Free Meta Router
best_for: General fallback queries when specific free endpoints are congested
limitations: Underlying model changes dynamically between turns
models.tested_verdict: High availability meta-router for background jobs.

models.name: Google Gemma 4 31B Instruct Free
models.tested_verdict: Very clean, balanced responses for documentation.

operational_guidelines.rotation_strategy: Rotate between OpenCode free models (GLM-5.3-Flash for repo sweeps, Nemotron-3.5 for CLI/linting, DeepSeek-V4.1 for mathematical review) and local Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B for zero-leak offline edits.
operational_guidelines.rate_limit_mitigation: Enforce 5-second minimum spacing on cloud free calls, caching common results in SQLite.
operational_guidelines.epistemic_verification: Always pass LLM generated code or proofs through deterministic compilers (PolyML, py_compile, unittest) before committing.
